info.name: VobbLiX - Card catalog + Thai translation test
info.description: Login, search the Vanguard card catalog, then open one card's detail view to trigger (and verify) the lazy Thai translation. Run the 3 requests in order - Login sets {{token}} automatically for the other two.

variable.description: Fill this in from a result of the 'Search cards' request below, then run 'Get card detail'.

exec: console.warn('no token in response - check email/password, or run node scripts/seed-test-accounts.js first');

request.description: Returns up to 25 matches. Copy any result's cardNumber into the 'cardNumber' collection variable, then run request 3.

First call for a given card: nameTh/skillTextTh will be null while it translates (a few seconds) if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY isn't set, or filled in if it is. Run this same request again - the second call reads the cached translation instantly.
